Because Pearson correlation only captures linear relationships, and most of your features are categorical or non-linear in effect.

A few points:

Only a few variables really move price in a straight-line way in your data, such as Area Type, Area Category, bedrooms, and baths.
Features like city, location, agency, agent, and province_name were factorized into integers, so the correlation values are not meaningful in a true numerical sense.
Some variables may still affect price, but not linearly, so correlation can be low or even negative.
date_added is not expected to have a strong direct relationship with price.

So it is not that only 4 features matter; it is that only 4 show a strong positive linear correlation.

one-hot encoding

    ('svr', SVR())
])
